# A lighter Consegna page on mobile — decisions

> Approved on 2026-10-14 at 11:35, round 4 · generated by fluidplan
> Tally: 6 accepted, 0 to change, 0 questions, 0 rejected, 0 without an answer (6 decisions).

## Context

Request (2026-10-14), after looking at the 2.30 preview on a phone: the mobile Consegna page is too full. (1) Notebook photos, note and tolti/rimessi should live in a section of their own, as a modal. (2) Maybe the cassa summaries should leave the Consegna page and show only once the consegna is closed. (3) In the participant card, the saldo before today (credito/debito) should move under Importo saldato.

Today (mobile, `public/consegna.html`): header, cassa row (Trovato/Incassato/Pagato/In cassa) + tolti/rimessi lines + quote teatro, status box with Chiudi/Annulla, Quaderno block, Note, tolti/rimessi rows, then the add select and the list "Chi ha ritirato". The participant card (`buildParticipantCardHTML` in `public/js/shared/consegna-common.js`) is full-screen at ≤ 768px and shows "prima di oggi" as a pill in its header.

Mockup: `design/mockups/consegna-mobile-compatta.html` (sections G, H, I = decisions F1, F2, F3). Ships together with the 2.30.0 work not yet released.

## Accepted decisions

### F1 · Detail, entrate/uscite, notebook and note in a sheet of their own

- **Importance:** Important
- **Phase:** Phase 1 — Lighter mobile Consegna page
- **Choice:** Taller summary box, full-screen sheet on tap
- **Why:** On a phone the list of people starts about two screens down: the turnista scrolls past cassa, status, notebook, note and rows at every person. Moving them changes where people look for things they learned last week, so it is worth one decision.
- **Proposal:** On mobile the page shows one taller box **without a title**: the details on several lines (**conto produttore**, **quote teatro**, the **movimenti di cassa with their motivo**), then a button-like footer **"Apri: dettaglio, entrate/uscite, quaderno, note ›"**. The whole box is one tap target and opens a **full-screen sheet** ("Dettaglio, entrate/uscite, quaderno, note") built like the participant card (back arrow, Salva): full cassa (Trovato, Incassato, Pagato, entrate/uscite, In cassa), quote teatro, Quaderno, **Entrate/uscite di cassa** (was "Soldi tolti o rimessi in cassa"), Note della giornata. The status buttons are **Annulla consegna** (left) and **Chiudi consegna** (right); where they sit is F5. Desktop unchanged.
- **Other options:** Collapsible block in the page (closed by default) (con: Still pushes the list down when open; Two kinds of 'open' on one page)
- **Remarks:** “closed box title should be: riepilogo, entrata/uscite cassa, teatro e note box can be taller and show multiline with: conto produttore, quote teatro, movimenti di cassa con motivo” (round 1); “The title should be separated from the multi line details and it should be clearer that i'ts clickable” (round 2); “"soldi tolti o messi in cassa" becomes "entrate/uscite di cassa" box loses title, button says "Apri: dettaglio, entrate/uscite, quaderno, note" swap annulla e chiudi buttons show me how the page scrolls, I need to understand which elements stay visbile soi I can decide where to put close/cancel buttons” (round 3)
- **History:** round 1: to change → round 2: to change → round 3: to change → round 4: accepted

### F5 · Where Annulla / Chiudi consegna sit on mobile

- **Importance:** Important
- **Phase:** Phase 1 — Lighter mobile Consegna page
- **Choice:** J3 · At the top, under the header
- **Why:** Closing happens once per consegna, after the cash is counted; a button that is hard to find gets the consegna left open, one that is always under the thumb gets tapped by mistake. On a phone only the bottom navigation stays on screen while scrolling.
- **Proposal:** **At the bottom of the page, after the list** (J1): reached by scrolling to the end, where the turnista is anyway when everyone has been entered. Annulla on the left, Chiudi on the right; both ask for confirmation.
- **Other options:** J1 · At the bottom, after the list (con: You must scroll to the end to close) · J2 · Fixed bar above the navigation (con: Takes screen from the list at every scroll; Close to the navigation: more accidental taps (confirmation still asked))

### F6 · Words on the cassa lines after the rename

- **Importance:** Minor
- **Phase:** Phase 1 — Lighter mobile Consegna page
- **Why:** The block is now "Entrate/uscite di cassa"; the lines in the summary box, the sheet, the close dialog and the Telegram report still say "Tolti dalla cassa" / "Rimessi in cassa" (decided in 2.30 A2). Mixed words on one screen read as two different things.
- **Proposal:** Lines become **"Uscite di cassa: tofu −20"** and **"Entrate di cassa: storno Altobelli +32,80"** everywhere (page, sheet, close dialog, report, manuals); the row switch keeps "− esce | + entra".

### F2 · Where the cassa summary is while the consegna is open

- **Importance:** Important
- **Phase:** Phase 1 — Lighter mobile Consegna page
- **Choice:** Summary box while open (F1), full cassa on the page when closed
- **Why:** Whoever counts the cash compares it with In cassa before closing. Hiding it while open removes a check the turnisti use; showing it on the page is what makes it full.
- **Proposal:** As in F1: while the consegna is open the page shows the taller summary box (conto produttore, quote teatro, movimenti di cassa with motivo); Trovato, Incassato and In cassa are inside the sheet. When the consegna is closed, the page shows the full cassa at the top, read-only, as today.
- **Other options:** Same summary box also when closed (con: A closed consegna no longer shows Trovato/In cassa at a glance)
- **Remarks:** “see f1” (round 1)
- **History:** round 1: to change → round 2: accepted → round 3: accepted → round 4: accepted

### F3 · "Prima di oggi" under Importo saldato in the card

- **Importance:** Important
- **Phase:** Phase 1 — Lighter mobile Consegna page
- **Choice:** Mobile and desktop
- **Why:** The saldo before today is what turns conto and versato into credito/debito; shown as a pill in the header it is read apart from the numbers it explains.
- **Proposal:** Remove the pill from the card header; show a row **"Prima di oggi: debito −53,44 €"** (or credito, or "pari") right under Importo saldato, before "Debito saldato per intero" / Lascia credito.
- **Other options:** Mobile only (con: Two layouts of the same card to maintain)
- **History:** round 1: accepted → round 2: accepted → round 3: accepted → round 4: accepted

### F4 · Docs and videos after the layout change

- **Importance:** Minor
- **Phase:** Phase 2 — Docs, video check and release
- **Why:** The manuals and the phone video clips show where note, uscite and the notebook are; after F1 several clips show a page that no longer exists.
- **Proposal:** Update the manuals and quick guide (mobile), and re-record the phone clips whose screens changed (consegna, uscite, chiudere), cut as today.
- **History:** round 2: accepted → round 3: accepted → round 4: accepted

## Glossary

- **sheet** (foglio) — A full-screen panel over the page with a back arrow, like the participant card on mobile.
